opportunities.title: The Binance CSO Called His Shot: He Described the $6.3B Hack Months Before It Happened
opportunities.why_now: A security exec publicly foreshadowed the exact attack vector used in one of the year's biggest hacks, and nobody acted on it.
opportunities.angle: Analysis piece dissecting the CSO's prior statements against the attack timeline — the 'we told you so' genre done with receipts, ending on what orgs should be monitoring for in their own exec's warnings right now.

opportunities.title: Across Protocol's 72 Hours: Hijacked Domain, Drained Wallets, Website Down — A Timeline of a Slow-Motion Rug

opportunities.title: 57 Cents Stolen for Every Dollar Earned Onchain: The Tax Nobody Votes On

opportunities.title: Initia Got Hacked Twice in Three Weeks — And That's Not Even Rare Anymore

opportunities.angle: Pattern-recognition post naming other 'twice-hacked' protocols from this year, arguing repeat exploits are now a predictable category worth tracking, not a fluke.

opportunities.title: Nakamoto Owes Kraken $165M — More Than the Company Is Worth
